mapper.select: SELECT d.store_id AS "storeId", s.currency AS "currency", SUM(d.impressions) AS "impressions", SUM(d.clicks) AS "clicks", SUM(d.spend) AS "spend", SUM(d.ad_sales) AS "sales", SUM(d.ad_orders) AS "orders" FROM ecom_ad_daily d JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = d.store_id WHERE d.ad_date >= #{begin} AND d.ad_date <= #{end} AND d.store_id = #{storeId} GROUP BY d.store_id, s.currency

SELECT d.store_id AS "storeId", s.currency AS "currency", d.ad_date AS "date", SUM(d.impressions) AS "impressions", SUM(d.clicks) AS "clicks", SUM(d.spend) AS "spend", SUM(d.ad_sales) AS "sales", SUM(d.ad_orders) AS "orders" FROM ecom_ad_daily d JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = d.store_id WHERE d.ad_date >= #{begin} AND d.ad_date <= #{end} AND d.store_id = #{storeId} GROUP BY d.store_id, s.currency, d.ad_date ORDER BY d.ad_date

SELECT d.store_id AS "storeId", s.name AS "storeName", s.currency AS "currency", d.seller_sku AS "sellerSku", SUM(d.clicks) AS "clicks", SUM(d.spend) AS "spend", SUM(d.ad_sales) AS "sales", SUM(d.ad_orders) AS "orders" FROM ecom_ad_daily d JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = d.store_id WHERE d.ad_date >= #{begin} AND d.ad_date <= #{end} AND d.seller_sku <> '' AND d.store_id = #{storeId} AND d.seller_sku LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') GROUP BY d.store_id, s.name, s.currency, d.seller_sku
SELECT t.ad_group_id AS "adGroupId", LOWER(t.target_text) AS "text" FROM ecom_ad_target t WHERE t.target_type = 'NEGATIVE' AND t.store_id = #{storeId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ecom_ad_campaign c WHERE c.status <> 'ARCHIVED' AND c.status = 'ENABLED' AND c.store_id = #{storeId}
